title: What If You Strapped on Wings on Titan?

scenes.text: What if you strapped on wings on Saturn's moon Titan? You could actually fly.
Titan has thicker air than Earth and weaker gravity, a perfect mix for flying.
University of Leicester students did the math. A normal wingsuit, 1.4 square meters, takes off at about 11 meters per second.
That's nearly Usain Bolt speed, so you'd want bigger wings instead.
Run at a human jogging pace of 6 meters per second and you'd need wings of about 4.7 square meters.
Earth can't do this. On Titan, a runner with big wings and a good start could lift off the ground.

description:
What if you strapped on wings on Titan?
